name: Nike Factory Store
description: Nike Factory Outlet Store near Mira Road, Thane offers an amazing selection of performance and athleisure apparel and footwear. It's got sportswear and accessories at remarkable prices which makes it the go to store for athletes. As the world’s leading sportswear brand, Nike’s mission is to bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete in the world

owner_posts.post_text: Step in to the techy, unconventional look of the Nike Zoom Air Fire. Nodding to the history of performance running, these sneakers create a fresh look with rich textures and layers. Exaggerated design lines and boldly framed Zoom Air cushioning combine with a thick foam midsole, adding comfort to go along with your defiant style.

Whether you're starting your running journey or an expert eager to switch up your pace, the Downshifter 13 is down for the ride. With breathable mesh and an updated internal fit band, it helps you find that extra gear or take that first stride towards chasing down your goals.

Up for a workout or down to chill, this Nike One Classic top is ready for whatever you are. Lightweight, silky-smooth fabric dries quickly and works for wherever your day takes you. A timeless, easy-fitting style and sweat-wicking tech help you feel confident, comfortable and dry from your morning stroll to your evening wind-down- and at all the stops in between.

Revolution 7 with the sort of soft cushioning and support that might change your running world. Stylish as ever, comfortable when the rubber meets the road, it's an evolution of a fan favourite that offers a soft, smooth ride.

The Nike Air Max Dawn is a retro-inspired, sporty sneaker featuring a lightweight, vintage running design with modernized Air cushioning. It combines a sleek neutral aesthetic with subtle, vibrant accents, making it an excellent everyday lifestyle shoe.
Fast-forward your footsteps in the cutting-edge Nike Interact Run. It’s set up with all the running goodness you need: a lightweight Flyknit upper, soft foam midsole and comfort where it counts

Take your gear to go with the Nike Heritage Backpack. Its spacious main compartment features a sleeve that holds up to a 15" laptop, so your computer is never out of reach. 2 zipped accessories pockets help keep your gear organized and easy to grab. This product is made from at least 65% recycled polyester fibres.
Wrap yourself in comfortable organic cotton. Made with slightly dropped shoulders, the loose fit brings a relaxed, casual feel.

Move with ease in these lightweight, sweat-wicking trousers that provide the perfect balance of room and stretch. Tapered legs allow you to run without distraction, while hand pockets let you stash your essentials. Plus, mesh panels behind the knees give you airflow when your miles heat up.
Stay comfortable on the path in this graphic running tee. Its smooth cotton-blend fabric is enhanced with Nike Dri-FIT tech, which moves sweat away from your skin for quicker evaporation.

featured_reviews.name: Parvez Charke
featured_reviews.review_text: I want to give a very big appreciation to Sailesh from the Nike store team. Today’s visit became one of my best shopping experiences purely because of his support, patience, and professionalism. From helping me try different sizes to understanding my style, he handled everything with genuine respect. I tried multiple shoes today — the Nike Air Max AP (Grey/Red), the Nike MC Trainer 2 (Black/White), and even the Nike Air Max Excee variant in the white-grey-orange combination. Sailesh helped me compare each model in terms of comfort, fit, cushioning, and overall support. He didn’t rush even once, and personally checked back-to-back sizes until I was completely satisfied. I finally selected the Nike Air Max AP in the Grey/Red colorway, and Sailesh made sure I got the perfect pair with the perfect fit. The way he guided me through every detail — from design to comfort level — really shows how dedicated he is towards customers. I was also carrying multiple shopping bags, and he still made the whole process smooth and stress-free. I genuinely feel employees like Sailesh are the reason customers trust a brand and come back again. Thank you, Sailesh, for turning a simple shoe purchase into a top-class experience. Full credit goes to you for your outstanding service.

featured_reviews.name: Pratik Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst Experience as no respect for customer and customers practical issues.

I purchased a Bata rainy shoes from here at around 10:10 p.m. and next morning I was going outstation. Later on, I went home and tried for 5 minutes by walking and thought shoes were little tight. I should get a size bigger.

I went at 10:25 p.m. and shop was not closed with owner and it's working staff still in store to exchange it. When I requested him, he said I cannot exchange it now. I am closing the shop, my staff will go, I have kept all the boxes. You come at 10:00 a.m. in the morning.

I requested him saying that please do a exchange I need to go to Pune in the morning at 06:30 a.m. He said no with reason come in morning, you wear and go what you did wear it today. I requested politely many 5-6 times and his answer was same.

So, I told that can I will never come to your shop to purchase as you are not understanding my issue of going outstation in morning when I am requesting and only kept on repeating your statement.

Later, I told okay than please take your shoes back and owner says I cannot take it back. It is not in policy. We can only exchange it. I told you are not ready to help me anyways, everything you want us to be done in your method and your way only. I told have purchased it 25 mins back only. He kept on saying no.

Than I have said in loud voice to negotiate with him for 10 mins. Later on he agreed to take return and refund money saying. Anyways, it is now 10:45 p.m., you will not get shoes from anywhere. Lets see where you will get it.

This was such worst experience provided to customer. The guy is just not worried about customers due to his shop in market area and good footfall organically. People must refrain from buying from such owners, so owner can also understand the importance of customers in market that we are one who can make and break you.

I got a shoes from other shop beside it Happy Fert Shoes at 10:55 p.m. He behaved very politely and assisted me in providing the shoes.

If you check the reply from owner still he is not able to understand the issue from customer and reply it without understanding it.

Just to add, post your reply - We purchased from your shop after checking once at your shop so a customer it does not mean we lose our right to exchange and refund.

Issue - You are not ready to understand that as a customer I was going out at morning 06:30 a.m.  outstation that is the reason someone who has purchased locally is coming at 10:30 p.m. from exchange. Even after so many requests owner is unable to understand request for exchange. If fact, the time as an owner you wasted yours and mine, you would have provided solution
